structured.rankingRationale: Top-ranked candidates combine exact future dates, direct La Côte geography, multi-day organized activity and a credible lodging/meeting/F&B mechanism. GDPM and OENOVITI outrank large Geneva events because they are local scientific programmes with participant accommodation relevance and less dependence on megashow housing. Paléo, Hivernales, FIFAN and Triathlon de Nyon follow for recurring local production/sports capture. Palexpo events remain valuable but rank lower for current accessibility because the venue is committed.
